label: rem:madelung-acoustic-metric
title: Acoustic metric and analogue gravity from the brane fluid
html:
Acoustic metric and analogue gravity. Perturbations \delta\psi around a background flow satisfy \Box_{g_{\mathrm{ac}}}\delta\psi = 0 for the acoustic metric

  g_{\mathrm{ac}}
  = 
  \frac{\rho}{c_s}
  \begin{pmatrix}
    -(c_s^2 - v^2) & -v^T \\
    -v & \mathbf{1}
  \end{pmatrix},
  \qquad
  c_s^2 = \frac{\partial P}{\partial\rho}\bigg|_{Q_q}.

An acoustic horizon forms wherever |v| = c_s, coinciding with a gravitational horizon in the substrate geometry. General relativity emerges as the geometry of non-uniform brane flow: the GR substrate geometry is precisely the acoustic manifold. Bosonic modes (where [F_A, \alpha] = 0) travel along null acoustic geodesics; fermionic modes ([F_A, \alpha] \neq 0) spiral into the vortex filaments of \psi.
